title: InferenceCarbon: A Bounded Estimation Framework for the Per-Token Carbon Intensity of LLM Inference Under Limited Disclosure
description:
Repository accompanying the InferenceCarbon framework paper: the collection engine, tracked-model manifests, tokenizer calibration runs, parameter tables (with per-row sources), and the scripts that reproduce the paper's tables from committed parameters and workbooks. The raw per-request corpus is archived as a separate frozen Zenodo deposit; data/manifest.csv in this repository carries the SHA-256 checksum of every corpus file and data/fetch_corpus.py retrieves and verifies it. Figures produced by this framework are bounded estimates published with Low/Central/High plausibility bands and qualitative confidence labels; the envelopes are part of the finding.
